scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
